name: fix_rust_shell_command_injection
description: std::process::Command via `sh -c` + interpolated string -> direct argv, no shell; incomplete-fix broken single-quote-escapes the value but still shells out
prompts: build_ping_command(host) in src/lib.rs builds its command by interpolating host into a shell string and running it via `Command::new("sh").arg("-c").arg(cmd_str)` - a hostile host value injects arbitrary shell commands. Fix it to invoke `ping` directly with its arguments passed individually (Command::new("ping").arg("-c").arg("1").arg(host)) - no shell involved at all, so the host value can never be interpreted as anything but a single literal argument. Do not try to escape/quote the value while still going through `sh -c`; that is not the fix. Keep the function name and signature.
